metadata.derivation: land: non-Water, or amphibious Water (land/waters-edge habitat, or unrecorded habitat + land secondary type or ground locomotion); sea habitat never amphibious; unrecorded pure-Water defaults strict. water_surface: Water type or learns Surf. deep_dive: learns Dive and water_surface (strict subset). air: Flying type, Levitate, or flying/hover locomotion.
metadata.hover_note: Binding build 3: explicit hover-by-design list (Bossy ruling on the Swdfm intake disagreement) — these 98 species are classed land-only by the derivation above but visibly hover in the source games; their levitate follower sheets are bound and this list is the record the air-domain check widens by. The derivation text and domains arrays are unchanged.
